item.title: refactor(orders): replace string order status with OrderStatus enum
item.brief:
The `orders` crate stores an order's status as a `String` and compares string literals throughout the code. Refactor it to a typed enum. Behaviour must not change.

Requirements:
- Add `src/status.rs` with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }`, deriving at least `Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash`.
- `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` returns the lowercase names: "pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled". `Display` prints the same text.
- `impl FromStr for OrderStatus` with `type Err = ParseStatusError`. `ParseStatusError` is a public error type that implements `std::error::Error` and whose message names the rejected input.
- `OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool` encodes the lifecycle: pending -> paid, pending -> cancelled, paid -> shipped, paid -> cancelled. Nothing else returns true.
- `Order::status` becomes an `OrderStatus`. Re-export `OrderStatus` and `ParseStatusError` from the crate root.
- Use the enum everywhere. The status string literals must appear only in `src/status.rs`.
- Observable behaviour stays exactly the same: errors, report output and ordering, and parsing. Characterize the current behaviour before changing it, and keep it.
- `cargo test` must pass. Add unit tests in `src/status.rs` for as_str, Display, parsing (including that the error message names the rejected input) and the transition table.

Repository constraints: the repository ships locally, so commit on the working branch and do not push. Commit only with the git identity already configured in the repository, and put no attribution or generated-by lines in the commit message. Follow the repository's CLAUDE.md rules. Keep functions under 60 lines.

Acceptance: `cargo test` passes; the status string literals appear only in `src/status.rs`; the work is committed.

stages.summary:
Baseline and characterization for the OrderStatus refactor. Nothing in src/ was changed.

Structural goal: replace `Order::status: String` with a typed `OrderStatus` enum (Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled), add `as_str`/Display, FromStr with `ParseStatusError`, and `can_transition_to`; re-export from the crate root; status literals only in src/status.rs. Behaviour must stay identical.

Commits (branch archon/3cbbxfkg-refactor-orders-replace-string-order-sta, not pushed, worktree clean):
- Original baseline: ae75825e1a42e3b25d521c784574295fd986fa26 (tree 6e35d20143ea2a04a1a2774dbb91a210c78ccdcf)
- Characterization: 4b1256809c93a3b0025d5b715cb3b40f7a12bd3d "test: characterize order status transitions, reports and line parsing" (tree 4b1256809c93a3b0025d5b715cb3b40f7a12bd3d... see note), adds only tests/characterization.rs (15 tests). Identity: repo-configured mengsig, no attribution lines.

Repo checks: no README, Makefile or CI config, so Cargo is the only check source.
- Before adding tests: `cargo test` exit 0 (3 tests pass). `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` exit 0. `cargo build` and `cargo doc --no-deps` exit 0. `cargo fmt --check` exit 1: pre-existing formatting diffs in src/billing.rs, src/order.rs, src/report.rs, src/shipping.rs and tests/orders.rs (not caused by this work; no rustfmt.toml). The refactorer will touch those lines and should decide whether to format them.
- After adding tests: `cargo test` exit 0 (15 characterization + 3 existing pass). Clippy `-D warnings` exit 0. `rustfmt --edition 2021 --check tests/characterization.rs` exit 0.
- All commands used `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` in the item cache. No services started.

Public surface to preserve (all in unchanged code):
- `Order { pub id: u32, pub customer: String, pub total_cents: u64, pub status: String }` with derives Debug, Clone, PartialEq. `Order::new(id, &str, u64)` starts pending. `is_open()` is true for pending or paid. `cancel()` is refused from shipped or cancelled.
- `billing::pay` succeeds only from pending. `shipping::ship` succeeds only from paid. Errors are "order {id} cannot be paid: it is {status}" and "order {id} cannot be shipped: it is {status}". Failed calls leave status unchanged. `cancel` error: "order {id} cannot be cancelled: it is {status}".
- `billing::outstanding_cents(&[Order]) -> u64` sums pending only. `shipping::ready_to_ship(&[Order]) -> Vec<u32>` lists paid ids in input order.
- `report::status_counts` returns `Vec<(String, usize)>` sorted by status NAME (alphabetical: cancelled, paid, pending, shipped), not lifecycle order. This is the main ordering trap.
- `report::to_line`: "id,customer,total_cents,status" (no trimming).
- `report::from_line`: trims the whole line only, not fields. Checks in this order: field count ("expected 4 fields, got N"), id u32 ("bad id {:?}: {e}"), total u64 ("bad total {:?}: {e}"), status ("unknown status {:?}"). Status matching is exact and case-sensitive. The error text must stay the same even if the refactorer routes it through FromStr/ParseStatusError.
- Only allowed contract change: `Order::status` type, per the brief. Arbitrary status strings can no longer be stored, which is expected.

Characterization coverage (tests/characterization.rs, 15 tests): pay/ship/cancel success and refusal from every status, with exact messages and unchanged status after failure; is_open per status; new-order defaults; outstanding_cents and ready_to_ship filtering and ordering; status_counts sort order with all four statuses, plus empty input; to_line for each status and round trip; from_line field count, error precedence (id, then total, then status), empty and negative numbers (exact Rust ParseInt messages), case and space sensitivity, whole-line trim vs field spaces, and empty customer. Tests use only to_string(), Display text and public functions, so they should compile after the enum change. Test helpers and tests/orders.rs are unchanged.

Known gaps and open issues for the refactorer and verifier:
1. Acceptance conflict: "status string literals appear only in src/status.rs". The existing tests/orders.rs and the new tests/characterization.rs contain literals such as "pending" and error text, which the characterization needs. Either the acceptance check is scoped to src/ (my recommendation), or the literals are removed from tests and the pinning weakened. This needs a decision from the parent, not an improvised choice.
2. report.rs KNOWN and the from_line status check should become enum parsing with the same error text.
3. No tests pin `Debug` output or the `status_counts` return type; the refactorer may change the type to `Vec<(OrderStatus, usize)>` only if it keeps the sort order and all tests still pass.
4. Gap: `Order` fields are public, so direct mutation isn't covered beyond the functions above.

Feedback: none (first attempt).

pr.body: Approach: src/status.rs holds OrderStatus (Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled) with as_str, Display (f.pad, keeps width behaviour), FromStr returning ParseStatusError whose Display is `unknown status "<input>"` so from_line keeps its exact error text, and can_transition_to encoding pending->paid/cancelled and paid->shipped/cancelled. billing::pay, shipping::ship and Order::cancel guard on can_transition_to, which is equivalent to the old status checks. Order::status is OrderStatus. report::status_counts keeps Vec<(String, usize)> and its name ordering by keying a BTreeMap on as_str. from_line keeps the field-count, id, total, status check order. Checks: cargo test 24 pass (15 characterization unchanged, 3 existing unchanged, 6 new unit tests in status.rs); clippy -D warnings, build and doc clean. Formatting-only commit precedes the change. Assumptions: acceptance literal check scoped to src/ since tests pin status text. Open: no asserts added per CLAUDE.md commandment 3 (structure-only refactor); Order Debug output changes (not pinned); tests/orders.rs still fails cargo fmt --check (pre-existing, untouched).
pr.summary: Made order status typed: OrderStatus enum with parsing and transition checks. Now: status literals only in src/status.rs; transitions via can_transition_to. Before: String status compared by literal in 4 modules. Now: same behaviour, same errors and report ordering.
pr.title: refactor(orders): replace string order status with OrderStatus enum

risk.why: Changes the public type of the Order::status field, which breaks any downstream caller that compares it to a string (brief-authorized, rubric lists API changes that break callers as high). Behaviour is unchanged: characterization tests (15) and existing tests (3) pass unmodified, plus 6 new unit tests. Files touched: src/status.rs (new), src/lib.rs, src/order.rs, src/billing.rs, src/shipping.rs, src/report.rs, plus one formatting-only commit. No tests modified.
